name: PdxForm
description:
A form that provides its Form to the controls and form fields inside it and validates them, with
save modes and DataSource integration.

members.name: name
members.description: Optional name for nested form registration with parent coordinator.

members.name: scrollToError
members.description: Scroll to first error field on failed validation.

members.name: formClass
members.description: CSS class for the inner <form> element.

members.name: source
members.description: DataSource for auto-load/save. When set, submit saves via DS.

members.name: recordId
members.description: Record ID to load from the DataSource.

events.name: pdx-submit
events.description: A submit passed validation: the values, and `saved` when a `source` stored them.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Optional name for nested form registration with parent coordinator.

attributes.name: scrolltoerror
attributes.description: Scroll to first error field on failed validation.

attributes.name: formclass
attributes.description: CSS class for the inner <form> element.

attributes.name: recordid
attributes.description: Record ID to load from the DataSource.

slots.description: The content placed inside the element.

cssStates.name: dirty
cssStates.description: A value differs from the one the form started from (or was last reset to).

cssStates.name: valid
cssStates.description: The form's `valid()`: no field has an error among the validations run so far.

cssStates.name: invalid
cssStates.description: Its last submit was refused, and an error is still there.
